responsibility: Declares the rs6000 D-front-end hook functions and binds them to GCC’s TARGET_D_* hook macros. Its role is to expose the PowerPC implementations from rs6000-d.cc as the target’s D language integration points for builtin CPU version registration and target-info query handling.
same_name_distinction: Binding/interface side of the rs6000-d pair: it declares the PowerPC D hook functions and assigns TARGET_D_CPU_VERSIONS and TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO, whereas rs6000-d.cc implements the hook behavior.
